stories.subject: 2 Chainz and Statik Selektah
stories.claim: Playaz Only Live Once is scheduled for December 4, 2026 as an 18-track album produced entirely by Statik Selektah, with A Week In Paris released as a preview.

stories.subject: GloRilla and Sexyy Red
stories.claim: Jiggly Bow Bow is scheduled for November 6, 2026 through CMG and Interscope after the artists teased the collaboration and revealed its cover art.

stories.subject: Megan Thee Stallion
stories.claim: The Tina Tuesday Freestyles EP collects Tina Tuesday, Is You Cool? and Thin Ice as Megan revives her Tina Snow alter ego ahead of another expected album.

stories.subject: Timbaland
stories.claim: Timbaland filed a 65-page Los Angeles complaint seeking more than $15 million from former managers and alleging fraud, civil theft and fiduciary breaches; the claims are unproven.

stories.subject: Rockstar Games workers and GTA VI
stories.claim: Rockstar developers are set to vote on union recognition November 12–26, overlapping GTA VI pre-loading and the November 19 console launch.

note: Each story was checked against at least two current reputable or primary sources. Original likenesses and scenes were grounded in current subject references without copying source photography.
